messages:
release-bot: Quick preflight bulletin before tomorrow's release window. Major items: 1) new dependency compatibility check is mandatory for any PR that touches runtimes or model loaders; 2) staggered rollout is now enforced for runtime changes (15% -> 40% -> 100% with checks at each step); 3) soft freeze starts 2025-11-10 18:00 UTC. Read checklist below.

andy: Can someone paste the compatibility check command? Want to add to CI.

rina: CI snippet: ```bash
# run compat check
python tools/check_compat.py --target-branch release --report out/compat.json
# fails CI if any runtime ABI changes detected
```
Add this to the `pre-merge` job for runtime PRs.

ops-oncall: Staggered rollout policy: default canary 15% for 30m, then 40% for 2h, then full ramp. At each stage: check user_error_rate, init_latency, and mem_pressure. Auto-rollback triggers on any of: user_error_rate +4% vs baseline, init_latency +50ms P95, or mem_pressure >85%.

dave: Small procedural change: runtime or loader PRs must include a `compat.md` short note describing ABI surface touched and a link to CI compat report. No PRs will merge without it during the freeze window.

vp-eng: Exec note: this freeze is to reduce surprise regressions for enterprise customers during the upcoming partner demo week. Keep rollouts conservative.

andy: Exemptions? If a P0 needs to land, what's the flow?

ops-oncall: Exemptions allowed for P0/P1 or security parche(s). Flow: open a release ticket, add label `freeze-exempt`, attach compat report, include an explicit rollback window and canary plan, then run `/exempt-approve PR-#### --approvers srl.lead,release.manager`. Exemptions auto-expire after 10 hours unless extended by SRE lead.

rina: Also, CI will now annotate PRs with a `compat-risk` badge based on the check_compat output. High-risk requires pair testing in staging before exemption is considered.

dave: Ops calendar slots for off-peak merges (UTC): Mon-Fri 01:00-03:00, Sat 05:00-08:00. Book via the release calendar and mention @ops-oncall to lock the slot.

release-bot: Quick preflight checklist (paste into PR description):
- compat.md attached and compat CI report link
- canary plan: regions, %s, duration
- rollback steps + expected downtime
- prewarm run (if model artifact >1GB) attached
- owners cc'd and SRE aware

andy: Will add the compat check to the runtime repo CI this afternoon.

vp-eng: Appreciate the coordination. Please keep messages short in this thread; open incident/rollout threads for live issues. Follow-up summary will be posted 2025-11-11 09:00 UTC with final canary readouts and exemption list. :loudspeaker:

ops-oncall: If you need help adding CI hooks, ping ops and we'll pair on a quick PR.

rina: I'll post the compat tool README in #eng-devex and link examples.

release-bot: End of bulletin. Stay safe and please test the compat check earlier rather than later.
